name: inbox-hooks
description: review-chain·auto-chain이 쓰는 받은편지함 훅(단독 사용 안 함). Inbox hooks used by review-chain and auto-chain (not for standalone use): asyncRewake waiters on Stop/StopFailure/UserPromptSubmit/SessionStart wake an idle Claude Code session when a line arrives in a subscribed agent-orchestrator inbox. No typing into the input box.
